cands.name: Cindy Banyai
cands.bio: Democrat. Former Florida Gulf Coast University professor; describes herself as a teacher, mom and small business owner with about 20 years in community development work with nonprofits. Ran for U.S. House (FL-19) in 2020 and 2022; no prior office.
cands.local_ties: Says she has spent most of the past two decades in Southwest Florida (WGCU voter guide). Filed from Lee County.

record.text: Unsuccessful candidate for U.S. House District 19 in 2020 and 2022; this is her fourth campaign for office. Has never held office.
Stated platform on her site: $22/hr minimum wage, summer sales tax holiday, rental increase cap, water pollution cleanup funding, ending corruption.

cands.gaps: No donor reporting or endorsements found (WGCU guide lists none). Photo is a Ballotpedia thumbnail (from her earlier congressional runs). Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.

cands.name: Susan Frantz
cands.bio: Republican, first-time candidate. Founder and CEO of Frantz Marketing Solutions, a Fort Myers marketing and public relations firm (15+ years); FGCU adjunct professor since 2023. Master's in sports administration, University of Miami (BallotReady).
cands.local_ties: Fort Myers native raised in Lee County with four siblings (her campaign site; Florida's Voice). Current home address not stated.

record.text: No prior elected office; had filed for this seat for 2028 before the incumbent's early departure. Names affordability as top issue; opposes tax increases (WGCU).

money_notes.text: Florida's Voice reported her with nearly $130,000 cash on hand in May 2026 (campaign-reported). Backed by Florida Realtors PAC, Florida Chamber and AIF (see endorsements).

endorsements.text: Florida Chamber of Commerce (July 13, 2026); Associated Industries of Florida (July 13, 2026); Florida Realtors PAC (July 17, 2026).

cands.gaps: Her site image is a logo, so no photo included. Controversy search not exhaustive. Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.
